narrative:
Aktia employs about 819 FTE across offices and advisors (330), Private Banking and Premium (85), asset management and fund operations (110), life insurance (45), IT and data (85), risk and compliance (70) and finance and group functions (94). In the target architecture the HR application is fed from SuccessFactors.

Comparable personnel costs are €1.3M over budget year-to-date after the collective agreement and slightly higher FTE. 15 positions are open.

Key lever: holding the 15 open positions through Q1 saves about €1.5M a year — half a point of CIR.
